lines:
LAST NIGHT, THE CAR PARK
KEPT YOU ALIVE.

NO BRAKES. NO LIGHTS.
NOBODY SAW YOU COME UP.

RULE 2. SLEEP IN THE BACK.
NEVER THE DRIVER'S SEAT.

FROM THE DRIVER'S SEAT,
YOU CAN'T SEE BEHIND YOU.

RECOVERY IN NINE DAYS.
STAY ABOVE STREET LEVEL.

3:40. IT OPENS. AND SOMEONE
LETS IT CLOSE SOFTLY.

“I KNOW YOU'RE ON FOUR.
I SAW YOUR BRAKE LIGHTS.”

NOBODY SAW YOU COME UP.
BRAKES: NEVER TOUCHED.
